options.content:
### watch → job → run → snapshot

| Table | Concern | Lifecycle |
|---|---|---|
| `availability_watch` | **User intent** — POI (or one reservable), dates, cadence, triggers. | Created by the user/API. Status: `active` / `paused` / `done`. |
| `availability_job` | **Scheduler state** — `next_run_at`, claim token, frozen `intent_payload`. **1:1 with watch.** | Service writes/updates this when a watch is created or edited. |
| `availability_job_run` | **Append-only execution log** — one row per poll: `started` / `completed` / `failed`, `snapshot_count`, `duration_ms`, `error`. | Inserted every time the executor runs a claimed job. |
| `availability_snapshot` | **Observed availability** — per `(reservable_id, target_date, observed_at)`. Linked to the run via `run_id`. | Inserted in bulk by the executor for each job run. |

### How to drill

Click a **watch_id** / **job_id** / **run_id** anywhere in the tables below to scope the whole dashboard. Clear a var (top bar) to widen back out. Use per-column filters inside each table for status / errors / etc.

### Where else to look

| Question | Dashboard |
|---|---|
| What did a single run write? Full payload. | **[Watch / Job Run Detail](/d/roadtrip-watch-job-run-detail)** — drill in via `run_id`. |
| Reservable-centric: full history + last fetch + watches scoped to one reservable. | **[Reservable / Detail](/d/roadtrip-reservable-detail)**. |
| POI-centric: linked reservables, coverage. | **[POI Detail](/d/roadtrip-poi-detail)**. |
| Fleet-wide fetch performance (latency, batch sizes, vendor splits). | **[Reservable / Availability Fetches](/d/roadtrip-reservable-availability-fetches)**. |

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'active') AS active_jobs,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'paused') AS paused_jobs,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'done') AS done_jobs,
  count(*) FILTER (
    WHERE j.status = 'active'
      AND j.next_run_at <= now()
      AND (j.claimed_until IS NULL OR j.claimed_until < now())
  ) AS due_now,
  count(*) FILTER (
    WHERE j.claimed_until IS NOT NULL
      AND j.claimed_until >= now()
  ) AS currently_claimed,
  count(*) FILTER (
    WHERE j.claimed_until IS NOT NULL
      AND j.claimed_until < now()
      AND j.last_run_at IS NULL
  ) AS expired_claim_without_run
FROM availability_job j;

SELECT
  w.id AS watch_id,
  w.status AS watch_status,
  j.id AS job_id,
  j.status AS job_status,
  CASE
    WHEN w.poi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'poi'
    ELSE 'reservable'
  END AS scope,
  w.poi_id,
  p.name AS poi_name,
  w.reservable_id,
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid,
  w.reservable_filters,
  w.start_date,
  w.end_date,
  w.cadence_sec AS watch_cadence_sec,
  w.trigger_kinds,
  w.trigger_config,
  w.stop_when_triggered,
  j.next_run_at,
  j.claimed_until,
  j.last_run_at,
  j.updated_at AS job_updated_at
FROM availability_watch w
LEFT JOIN availability_job j ON j.watch_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = w.poi_id
LEFT JOIN reservables r ON r.id = w.reservable_id
WHERE (${watch_id:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR w.id::text IN (${watch_id:sqlstring}))
  AND (${job_id:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR j.id::text IN (${job_id:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY
  j.next_run_at ASC NULLS LAST,
  w.created_at DESC,
  w.id DESC;

SELECT
  j.watch_id,
  jr.job_id,
  jr.id AS run_id,
  jr.status AS run_status,
  jr.snapshot_count,
  jr.duration_ms,
  jr.error,
  jr.started_at,
  jr.completed_at,
  w.poi_id,
  p.name AS poi_name,
  w.reservable_id,
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid
FROM availability_job_run jr
JOIN availability_job j ON j.id = jr.job_id
JOIN availability_watch w ON w.id = j.watch_id
LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = w.poi_id
LEFT JOIN reservables r ON r.id = w.reservable_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(jr.started_at)
  AND (${watch_id:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR j.watch_id::text IN (${watch_id:sqlstring}))
  AND (${job_id:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR jr.job_id::text IN (${job_id:sqlstring}))
  AND (${run_id:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR jr.id::text IN (${run_id:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY jr.started_at DESC, jr.id DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  j.watch_id,
  jr.job_id,
  s.run_id,
  jr.status AS run_status,
  s.id AS snapshot_id,
  s.reservable_id,
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_rid,
  w.poi_id,
  p.name AS poi_name,
  s.target_date,
  s.status::text AS observed_status,
  s.available,
  s.observed_at
FROM availability_snapshot s
LEFT JOIN availability_job_run jr ON jr.id = s.run_id
LEFT JOIN availability_job j ON j.id = jr.job_id
LEFT JOIN availability_watch w ON w.id = j.watch_id
LEFT JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id
LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = w.poi_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.observed_at)
  AND (${watch_id:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR j.watch_id::text IN (${watch_id:sqlstring}))
  AND (${job_id:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR jr.job_id::text IN (${job_id:sqlstring}))
  AND (${run_id:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR s.run_id::text IN (${run_id:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY s.observed_at DESC, s.id DESC
LIMIT 300;
